## THE ROOTS OF AUTHENTIC8

Silo was the first platform to deliver a secure, cloud-native browser and global network for isolating, anonymizing, and geolocating web access — a breakthrough that elite intelligence teams in the public and private sectors quickly adopted for digital investigations.

Our reach now spans Fortune 500 brands and federal agencies charged with national security and defense, all trusting Silo to protect their operations and speed their insights.

Today, Silo is a fully centralized investigative platform, empowering organizations to engage directly without exposure in pursuit of critical intelligence. Teams rely on us to investigate and counter global threats — including geopolitical risks, cyber threats, financial crimes, drug and human trafficking, and physical security risks.
